# Support

## Bugs and feature requests

File a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/Caezarr/mirror-site/issues). Include browser, page URL, and a screenshot if layout/SEO related.

## Security vulnerabilities

Use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Caezarr/mirror-site/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Questions

Best-effort only; no support SLA for this personal site.
